name: attention-dock-narrow-pane
description: Session: a dormant conversation's attention dock in a narrow pane keeps a long next-session title inside the pane. The dock used to carry only a right anchor, so the control's own ceiling (min(18rem, 55vw)) grew it past the pane's left edge, where the scaffold clipped part of Next away.

mutation.declaration: panes/session/session.module.css: .attentionDock { left: var(--space-3) } (deleted - the pre-fix right-only anchor lets the 328px control start left of a 300px pane)
